facts.label: Highest Score
facts.headline: {{num}} — Ainsworth
facts.sub: Week 1, in a 97-point demolition of Zogg. The 2nd-highest Week 1-2 score in 13+ years of NWL history — trails only Muenchow's 172.30 in 2018.

facts.label: Biggest Season-Opening Blowout Ever
facts.headline: Ainsworth by {{num}} 🔥
facts.sub: The biggest Week 1-2 margin specifically in 13 years of NWL history — the old Week 1-2 mark was Muenchow's 67.98-point win over Stover in 2022, beaten by 29 points. It's not the biggest blowout ever, though — that's still Conlin's 127.6-point demolition of Zogg (202.4-74.8) in Week 3, 2019.

facts.label: Lowest Score
facts.headline: {{num}} — Palaia
facts.sub: Week 2 loss to Larson. The 5th-lowest Week 1-2 score since 2013 — and Palaia's also 0-2 with the league's worst points against (254.6).

facts.label: Scoring Era Check
facts.headline: {{num}}-highest scoring start since 2013
facts.sub: Of 14 seasons. 101.0 PPG through two weeks puts 2026 well above the 2023-2025 stretch (92-97 PPG), though still short of the 2018-2021 boom that averaged 109-116.

facts.label: Larson's Rare Hot Start
facts.headline: Only the {{num}} time in 13 years
facts.sub: Larson has started 2-0 just twice before (2013-2025). Glaser and Ainsworth — the other two current 2-0 teams — have each done it 3 times; Palaia leads the league all-time with 7, one ahead of Conlin's 6.

facts.label: Does 2-0 Mean Anything?
facts.headline: Only {{num}} of 39 historical 2-0 starts won it all
facts.sub: 13 of those 39 teams still missed the playoffs entirely by season's end. A hot start is fun to have, but history says it's no guarantee of anything.

facts.label: Nailbiter of the Season
facts.headline: Prodahl by {{num}}
facts.sub: Edged Stover 84.92–72.98 in Week 2 — the closest game either week.

facts.label: Riser of the Week
facts.headline: Zogg jumped {{num}} in the power rankings
facts.sub: From 12th (fresh off that record-setting Week 1 beating) to 6th, after answering with the Week 2 high score, 138.86. Biggest single-week move in the league so far.

facts.label: League-Wide Waiver Activity
facts.headline: {{num}} total pickups, $240 in FAAB spent
facts.sub: 37 came free off the wire with no bid at all — including 8 Head Coach swaps as managers chase a better bye-week matchup. Palaia leads the league with 14 moves, more than double the next-busiest manager (Goetz, 9).

facts.label: Glaser Does It Again
facts.headline: The first back-to-back {{num}} start in NWL history
facts.sub: Glaser also opened 2025 at 3-0. 17 teams had started 3-0 from 2013-2025, and none of them did it two years running. Before last season, Glaser's best start was 2-1, and he'd opened 0-3 twice (2016, 2020).

facts.label: Does 3-0 Mean Anything?
facts.headline: {{num}} of 17 historical 3-0 starts made the playoffs
facts.sub: Three of them won it all: Palaia (2013 and 2018) and Conlin (2020). The lone exception is Conlin's 2018 team, which started 3-0 and finished 7th.

facts.label: Highest Score
facts.headline: {{num}} — Palaia
facts.sub: Week 3's top score, powered by Bijan Robinson (34.3) and Brock Bowers (22.6). The 59.02-point win over Pfaffinger was also the week's biggest margin.

facts.label: Lowest Score
facts.headline: {{num}} — Zogg
facts.sub: Zogg's second sub-70 game in three weeks (68.50 in Week 1), with the Week 2 high score of 138.86 in between. That's 7 sub-70 regular-season games for Zogg since 2022, the start of the current scoring era.

facts.label: Nailbiter of the Season
facts.headline: Stover by {{num}}
facts.sub: 101.28–99.10 over Ainsworth, the closest game of 2026 so far (the old mark was Prodahl's 11.94 in Week 2). Ainsworth's Ravens Head Coach scored +5 on the bench, enough to flip the result.

facts.label: Benched: Most Points
facts.headline: {{num}} from Brock Purdy, on Hagan's bench
facts.sub: The most points by any QB in the league in Week 3. Hagan started Jalen Hurts (12.6) instead and still beat Zogg 85.62–68.84. At 2-1, Hagan has scored less than he's allowed (268.7 PF vs. 269.6 PA).

facts.label: Benched: Most Costly
facts.headline: Larson lost by {{num}}
facts.sub: Michael Wilson scored 20.4 on Larson's bench while Devaughn Vele scored 5.4 in the lineup. That one swap was worth 15.0 points, more than twice the margin, and Terry McLaurin (16.7) sat on the bench too.

facts.label: From 3-0 to 0-3
facts.headline: Pfaffinger's {{num}} 0-3 start
facts.sub: Pfaffinger opened 2025 at 3-0. His other 0-3 starts were 2020 and 2022, which ties Hagan, Goetz, and Larson for the most in league history. None of the 18 teams that started 0-3 from 2013-2025 won a title, and only 4 made the playoffs.

facts.label: Worst Luck in the League
facts.headline: {{num}} points against
facts.sub: Pfaffinger's points against lead the league by 42.5, the 9th-most through three weeks in NWL history. Pfaffinger has seen worse: his 2020 team faced 394.8 (2nd-most ever), started 0-3, and still finished 5th.

facts.label: Week 4 Game of the Week
facts.headline: The all-time series is tied {{num}}
facts.sub: #1 Glaser (3-0) vs. #2 Ainsworth (2-1, league-high 382.9 points for). ESPN has Glaser favored by 11. Their last meeting, Week 10 of 2025, went to Ainsworth 113.54–112.20.

facts.label: Four-Way Logjam
facts.headline: {{num}} teams tied for first at 3-1
facts.sub: Ainsworth, Glaser, Goetz, and Larson. From 2013-2025, 39 teams started 3-1. 29 of them made the playoffs and 8 won the title.

facts.label: Highest Score
facts.headline: {{num}} — Goetz
facts.sub: Chuba Hubbard (25.4) and Emanuel Wilson (25.5, from the flex) led the way in a win over Pfaffinger. Goetz started 0-4 last year and finished 12th. This year he's 3-1.

facts.label: Lowest Score
facts.headline: {{num}} — Glaser
facts.sub: Glaser's perfect start ended against Ainsworth (99.34), who now leads the all-time series 13-12. Glaser is 3-1 after four weeks for the second straight year.

facts.label: The 0-4 Club
facts.headline: Pfaffinger's {{num}} 0-4 start
facts.sub: His first was 2020. Larson (2013, 2015) and Hagan (2021, 2022) are the only other managers to do it twice. None of the 9 teams that started 0-4 from 2013-2025 won a title, and only 2 made the playoffs.

facts.label: Worst Luck in the League
facts.headline: {{num}} points against
facts.sub: The 4th-most through four weeks in NWL history. The closest comparison is Pfaffinger's own 2020 team, which faced 504.6, started 0-4, and still finished 5th.

facts.label: Last Year's Unbeatens
facts.headline: A combined {{num}}
facts.sub: Conlin and Pfaffinger both opened 2025 at 5-0. In 2026, Conlin is 1-3 with three straight losses and Pfaffinger is 0-4.

facts.label: Benched: Most Costly
facts.headline: {{num}} points on Prodahl's bench
facts.sub: That's what Drake Maye (26.2 on the bench, over Kyler Murray's 11.5) and Kyle Monangai (27.5 on the bench, over TreVeyon Henderson's 4.2) would have added. Prodahl was an 18-point favorite and lost to Zogg by 29.32. In Week 3 he made the opposite call and started Maye (3.8) over Murray (10.4).

facts.label: Benched Again
facts.headline: Purdy +{{num}}
facts.sub: Brock Purdy has outscored Jalen Hurts 50.9 to 26.1 over the last two weeks without starting either game for Hagan.

facts.label: Wasted Boom
facts.headline: {{num}} from Tetairoa McMillan
facts.sub: The top score by any rostered player in Week 4, and Pfaffinger still lost by 18.22. Benching Rashee Rice (0.0) and Bhayshul Tuten (10.1) for KC Concepcion (8.9) and Alvin Kamara (20.3) would have won it.

facts.label: Trade Market
facts.headline: {{num}} trades completed
facts.sub: ESPN has logged 34 player-trade proposals since the draft, and 22 of them came from Zogg. None have been accepted.

facts.label: Week 5 Game of the Week
facts.headline: #12 is favored over #1 by {{num}}
facts.sub: 0-4 Pfaffinger hosts 3-1 Ainsworth. Pfaffinger leads the all-time series 12-5 and won the last meeting, 82.06–65.06 in Week 14 of 2025.

facts.label: Highest Score
facts.headline: {{num}} — Muenchow
facts.sub: The highest score in any NWL game since the current scoring era began in 2022, and 7th-highest in league history. Muenchow's best is still 172.30, from Week 1 of 2018.

facts.label: Biggest Blowout
facts.headline: Muenchow by {{num}}
facts.sub: Over Larson, the second-biggest margin of 2026. Ainsworth's 97.06-point win over Zogg in Week 1 is still the biggest.

facts.label: Lowest Score
facts.headline: {{num}} — Pfaffinger
facts.sub: Tetairoa McMillan and Bryce Young were on Carolina's bye, and Rashee Rice was on Kansas City's.

facts.label: The 0-5 Club
facts.headline: Pfaffinger is the {{num}} team to start 0-5
facts.sub: After Larson (2015), Ainsworth (2018), Hagan (2021), and Goetz (2025). None of them made the playoffs, and the best finish was 9th. It's Pfaffinger's first 0-5 start.

facts.label: Tied at the Top
facts.headline: {{num}} of 22 teams that started 4-1 made the playoffs
facts.sub: Ainsworth and Glaser are both 4-1. Five of the 22 historical 4-1 teams won the title, most recently Muenchow in 2025.

facts.label: Right QB, Finally
facts.headline: {{num}} from Drake Maye
facts.sub: The top score by any rostered player in Week 5. Prodahl picked the wrong quarterback in Weeks 3 and 4. This time Maye started, and Prodahl beat Palaia.

facts.label: Benched Again (and Again)
facts.headline: Purdy +{{num}} over three weeks
facts.sub: Brock Purdy has outscored Jalen Hurts from Hagan's bench three straight weeks: by 18.7, 6.1, and 3.2.

facts.label: Sub-70 Club
facts.headline: {{num}} games under 70 in five weeks
facts.sub: Zogg scored 68.50, 68.84, and 69.84, with 138.86 and 121.10 in between. Week 5's included 1.9 points from CeeDee Lamb.

facts.label: Hot Streak
facts.headline: Stover's {{num}}-game win streak
facts.sub: The longest active win streak in the league. Stover has also played the hardest schedule so far.

facts.label: Most Points Left on the Bench
facts.headline: {{num}} — Glaser
facts.sub: Through five weeks, compared with Glaser's best possible lineup each week. He's 4-1 anyway. Goetz has left the fewest (31.9).

facts.label: Week 6 Game of the Week
facts.headline: Muenchow leads the series {{num}}
facts.sub: #4 Muenchow, coming off 168.22, hosts #2 Ainsworth. Based on each team's best projected lineup, Ainsworth is favored by 9.5. Muenchow won their last meeting, 124.48–102.72 in Week 5 of 2025.

facts.label: Owned
facts.headline: Prodahl leads Ainsworth {{num}}, the most lopsided rivalry in NWL history
facts.sub: They meet this week, with Prodahl favored by 1. Hagan and Goetz also play, and Goetz's 13-3 lead is the third-most lopsided series ever, behind Muenchow's 16-3 over Larson (series of 12+ games).

facts.label: Dodged It
facts.headline: Pfaffinger avoids {{num}}
facts.sub: Only two teams have ever started 0-6, and neither stopped there: Larson (2015) went to 0-7, and Goetz (2025) to 0-8, the worst start in NWL history. The bad news: 17 teams have been 1-5 after six games, and none made the playoffs.

facts.label: A Rough Week for Everyone
facts.headline: League average: {{num}}
facts.sub: 9.5% below the 2026 average, the 13th-worst week of 185 since 2013 measured against its own season. The worst: Week 1 of 2023, 18.6% below, when nobody reached 100.

facts.label: Won With Two Zeros
facts.headline: Glaser started {{num}} zero-point players and won
facts.sub: Cam Skattebo and Juwan Johnson both played and scored 0. From 2022-2025, teams did that 11 times in the regular season and won three of them.

facts.label: Sub-70 Club
facts.headline: Zogg has {{num}} games under 70 in six weeks
facts.sub: 68.5, 68.8, 69.8 and now 61.1. That ties 2017 Ainsworth for the most sub-70 games through six weeks in league history.

facts.label: All Square
facts.headline: Week 6 evened {{num}} of the league's longest rivalries
facts.sub: Pfaffinger's first win tied his series with Conlin at 11-11 (Conlin led 11-10). Goetz's 4.5-point win tied Goetz vs. Palaia at 12-12, now the most-played tied series in league history at 24 games.

facts.label: Coaching on Bye
facts.headline: {{num}} Head Coaches started on a bye
facts.sub: Conlin started the Lions coach and Palaia the Vikings coach. Detroit and Minnesota both had Week 6 off, so both scored 0.

facts.label: Lucky Streak
facts.headline: Stover's {{num}}-game win streak
facts.sub: The longest active streak in the league. His 81.0 was the lowest winning score of 2026, and his 2.2 expected wins are the fewest of any team with a winning record.

facts.label: Playoff Race
facts.headline: Prodahl's odds: {{num}}
facts.sub: Up to 65%, the biggest jump of the week. Larson had the biggest drop, 14 points, to 34%.
